posts.title: Welcome to Our New Website
posts.author: FBC Sunset
posts.excerpt: We're glad you're here. Welcome to the family at First Baptist Church Sunset.
posts.content:
## Hello, Friend!

We're so glad you've found us online. First Baptist Church Sunset is a small-town church with a big heart for our community and for Jesus.

Whether you're visiting for the first time or you've been part of our family for years, we hope this site helps you stay connected with what's happening here in Sunset, Texas.

### Plan a Visit

We'd love to meet you in person! Join us on Sundays for Bible study at **9:45 AM** and worship at **10:30 AM**.

407 TX-511 Spur, Sunset, TX 76270

See you soon!
